svg.title: Turning every two hours, hourly incentive spirometry while awake, and ankle pumps were started 48 hours ago. Highlight the findings that show the plan is NOT working.
svg.desc: The plan is already running, so this question asks for evidence that it is failing. New crackles at one base, an empty spirometer log, a nonblanchable red heel and a calf three centimeters larger than the other side all say the plan is either not being carried out or is not enough. Clear upper lobes, a saturation of 97 percent, full ankle range and a bowel movement are the parts that are working. The heel is the trap for anyone who checks only the sacrum, since NPIAP prevention guidance calls for floating the heels off the bed.
